title: Synthesis: equilibrium from both sides
summary: The synthesis-week unit: the thermodynamic view of equilibrium (ΔG° = −RT ln K, temperature dependence through ΔH°) and the kinetic view (K = k_f/k_r for elementary steps, temperature dependence of rate constants through E_a) brought together on one system chosen by the learner, with the assumptions of each view stated; preparation for the written synthesis assessment.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; it revisits lecture 18 pages 1–2, lecture 31 page 4 and lecture 33 page 6 of 5.111SC with OpenStax 13.1 and 16.4.

preparation.description: Lecture 18 notes page 2: ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q and ΔG° = −RT ln K.
Lecture 31 notes page 4: K as the ratio of forward and reverse rate constants.
Lecture 33 notes page 6: rate constants versus equilibrium constants with temperature.
OpenStax 16.4 Free Energy (free energy and equilibrium) and 13.1 Chemical Equilibria (dynamic equilibrium).

activities.title: Revisiting the two views of equilibrium
activities.instructions: Re-read the three lecture-notes pages and the two OpenStax sections for this unit with the question: which assumptions does each view make, and where do they meet? The prepared synthesis guidance and exercises are not yet written; this outline shows exactly what the unit will cover.
